scope: Diagnostic dual-USB reservation with causal TailPermit. Not product RF reservation and not hardware acceptance.

validation.note: Initial insufficient fixture; preserved, not genuine RED.

Actual existing Vehicle TDD issues Grant before a diagnostic release because the legacy path has no reservation seam. This is not a legacy product defect or an assertion that the unchanged legacy API was repaired.

contracts.record_journal: first 8 plus last 4 chronological events; first failure freezes entire snapshot/record
contracts.reply_queue: Fixed 8 entries, no clearing/reordering on failure because a front reply may have an in-flight USB prefix. Pop only after complete whole-frame publication.

failure_hardening: Commands and callbacks enforce already-expired original phase deadlines, even without an intervening periodic tick.
Delayed actual-Held callback cannot create a new deadline from a stale t0.
Unknown record enums, inconsistent fault states, non-monotonic journal entries and premature failure events are rejected before record mutation.
Epoch zero accepted when identity/scope is present; local epoch changes fail closed.
All wire time overflow is rejected rather than truncated; internal timestamps/JTAG remain 64-bit.
Generic Fault never overwrites the real action token or writer generation.
caller_obligations: Parent bridge must bind the exact canonical held #21 and actual original owner t0. Core does not manufacture or reset adapter admission.

Prepare callback must represent an actual issued standard TDD SendGrant action with acquired unchanged StandardTdd writer lease. Root controls actual zero-write hold/release and all hardware safety conditions.
Tail callback is only a physically validated matching Grant tail (E220/AUX/service-floor evidence), never UART acceptance, USB release, prefix or PC time.
VCBN callback is only a complete validated canonical frame tied to the matching Grant. Controller is not a MAVLink/VCBN parser.
Ground local and Vehicle local clocks are never directly subtracted. Forwarded peer timestamps are claims recorded separately from local causal receipt.
Reader/nonce/CRC and trusted-PC relay do not authenticate that PC, prove RF timing bounds, or grant product acceptance.
Controller Hello may await the next actual baseline RF Grant without synthesizing a reception time. Runner must enforce the separate preparation timeout.
Original adapter 28-second lease and PC 30-second total remain separately enforced; Started retires only diagnostic reservation phase timers.
limitations: Synthetic controller tests are not physical RF proof.
USB relay plus causal 100 ms guard and RF delivery may fail the unchanged Vehicle 500 ms window; such a result must be reported without extending or resetting deadlines.
No claim of bulk success, VCRC completion, 932/932 within 30 seconds or product acceptance.
